coupon_value_check.name: coupon_value_check
coupon_value_check.value: ("coupon"."kind" = 'percent') = ("coupon"."percent_bp" is not null) and ("coupon"."kind" = 'fixed') = ("coupon"."amount_cents" is not null)

coupon_window_check.name: coupon_window_check
coupon_window_check.value: "coupon"."ends_at" is null or "coupon"."starts_at" is null or "coupon"."ends_at" > "coupon"."starts_at"

download_link_revoked_check.name: download_link_revoked_check
download_link_revoked_check.value: ("download_link"."revoked_at" is null and "download_link"."revoked_reason" is null) or ("download_link"."revoked_at" is not null and "download_link"."revoked_reason" in ('order_status','renewed'))

checkout_lead_converted_check.name: checkout_lead_converted_check
checkout_lead_converted_check.value: "checkout_lead"."status" <> 'converted' or ("checkout_lead"."email" is null and "checkout_lead"."phone" is null)
